title: Accommodation
intro: 4–5 star throughout; US booking platforms (Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Hyatt, Expedia). Value-conscious in Beijing; splurge in Vietnam. Beachfront resort base in Đà Nẵng for the perfect-day template.

rows: Best luxury in Dongcheng; spa; Wangfujing walking distance
Legend property; closest to Forbidden City — RECOMMENDED

rows: Iconic 1901 property; Hoan Kiem walk — RECOMMENDED

Business district; larger rooms; Marriott Bonvoy

rows: Cliff-top Son Trà; private beach — SPLURGE PICK

tables.caption: Budget Summary
rows: Leaves $13–15K for flights, activities, food, shopping

bullets.heading: Neighborhood Rationale
items: Beijing: Dongcheng / Wangfujing — walking distance to Forbidden City, Wangfujing, hutongs
Hanoi: Old Quarter / Hoan Kiem Lake — all activities walkable; safe at night
Đà Nẵng: Mỹ Khê / Non Nước Beach (NOT Hội An town) — 20 min to Hội An, 15 min to Marble Mountains

bullets.heading: Cross-Border Logistics
items: Beijing Day 1: Request early check-in; bags held if room not ready
Hanoi Day 6: Room pre-blocked; Metropole concierge at airport if arranged
Đà Nẵng Day 8: Early check-in; resort lunch before room ready
Đà Nẵng Day 14: Late checkout (2 PM typical); luggage storage available

callouts.text: All properties bookable on US platforms; 4–5 star throughout — no hostels or Airbnb
All accommodations within 30 min of 60%+ of planned activities
Splurge allocated to Vietnam (Đà Nẵng resort) as per profile
Book Đà Nẵng resort with free cancellation — typhoon risk in September justifies flexible booking
